title: Why height makes a bell curve: continuous variation
examples: Why does height make a bell-shaped graph?
Is blood group continuous or discontinuous?

explain.say: Imagine lining up everyone in your school from shortest to tallest. Would you see big jumps, or a smooth slope? Let's draw what really happens.

draw.text: Why height makes a bell curve: continuous variation

explain.say: Look at the top of the curve. Most people are close to the middle height, so that column is the tallest. Variation like this, where any value in a range is possible, is called continuous variation. Where do you think you would stand?
Now the two ends. Only a few people are very short or very tall, so the curve drops down on both sides. That shape is called a bell curve, or normal distribution. Can you see the bell?

Why so smooth? Height is affected by many genes plus food and health, which mix together. Blood group is different: you are A, B, AB or O, nothing in between. That is discontinuous variation. Which kind is shoe size?
So many small causes add up to a smooth bell. Brilliant thinking! Challenge: measure the hand spans of ten friends and see if a bell starts to appear.

faq.a: Continuous variation is when a feature can have any value within a range, like height, mass or hand span. It is shown on a histogram or line graph, often as a bell curve.
asks: Tell me about most in the middle

faq.a: A bell curve, or normal distribution, is a graph that is high in the middle and low at both ends. Most values are near the average and only a few are far from it.
asks: Tell me about the ends of the curve

faq.a: Discontinuous variation has a few separate groups with nothing in between, like blood group or whether you can roll your tongue. It is shown on a bar chart.

faq.q: Why does height vary so smoothly?
faq.a: Height is controlled by many genes, each adding a little, and also by food, health and sleep while growing. All these small effects blend into a smooth range.

faq.q: Is shoe size continuous or discontinuous?
faq.a: Foot length is continuous, but shoe sizes are put into steps, so shoe size data looks discontinuous. Scientists say the feature itself, foot length, varies continuously.

facts: Human height is influenced by thousands of genetic variants as well as diet and health.
Continuous variation is usually shown as a histogram; discontinuous variation as a bar chart.

quiz.show: Which of these shows discontinuous variation?
quiz.why: Blood group falls into a few separate groups (A, B, AB, O) with nothing in between.

wrong.0: Height can be any value in a range, so it is continuous.
wrong.2: Body mass can be any value in a range, so it is continuous.

quiz.say: In a bell curve of heights, where are most people?
quiz.show: In a bell curve of heights, where are most people?
quiz.why: The peak of the curve is in the middle, near the average height.

wrong.0: Only a few people are at the shortest end.
wrong.2: Only a few people are at the tallest end.
